free_tier.stated: No free tier. SLICE 512 is USD 24.00 a year; SLICE 1024 is USD 3.50 a month and is not sold annually on this page.

retention.stated: The slice persists while the term is paid; the page states no deletion schedule.

egress.terms: Unmetered bandwidth, in the vendor's wording 'Unmetered Dedicated KVM Slice Servers'; the SLICE 512 card prints no port speed, and the 1000 Mbps figure appears only in the separate HIGH VOLUME VPS PLANS table for the 8 GB and larger slices.

interface_detail: KVM slice with unmetered transfer; the card prints no port speed.
tooling: Any SSH client; KVM, so its own kernel.
chaining: USD 24.00 a year buys 512 MB with unmetered transfer and a real IPv4: twice ceiling, but the cheapest unmetered machine found here.

limits.value: unmetered transfer with no port speed printed on the SLICE 512 card; the vendor states no volume cap, so throughput under contention is the practical limit

binding_note: With no traffic quota, the only thing that degrades is throughput under contention on a shared port; the SLICE 512 card prints no port speed.

identity_cost.detail: Self-service order with an email account; the page read states no card hold and lists no payment methods.

reliability_note: Long-running provider with a block-storage product on the same account.
confidence_note: the annual price, the shape and the unmetered transfer are quoted from the plan card; the stock state is quoted from the vendor's plan script and the cart page, which disable every location and answer Out of Stock
